title: structured format
rule: When a strict syntax is required, put that structure into the control (segmented fields or visible separators) instead of a blank box.

citation.source: Designing Interfaces 3e ch. Getting Input — Structured Format (Tidwell, Brewer, Valencia)

pass_when: Strict-syntax values use segmented fields or visible separators.
fail_when: Strict syntax is a blank box plus after-the-fact format errors only.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
